title: Creative Expression Without Evaluation
opening: Make a small mark, phrase, sound or arrangement for yourself. If a rating appears, notice it and return to the making. No one needs to see or keep the result; you can stop whenever you want.

labels.afterward: Keeping it later is a choice
labels.boundary: When a result is for someone else
labels.observation: What happened to your attention or next move? If useful, compare it with another time you made something.
labels.limit: Save notes are limited to 2,000 characters. If your draft is longer, shorten it here; the full text stays in this field.

work.title: A sketch changes course
work.description: While sketching a loose loop, someone thinks, “This should look like a flower.” They notice the rating and extend the curve into another line. It can stay a loop; no one needs to see it.

keeping.title: Keeping it later is a choice
keeping.description: Keeping something afterward does not undo the practice. The point is that saving or showing it was not required in order to begin.

boundary.title: When a result is for someone else
boundary.description: If someone depends on the result, keep the checks and commitments that protect them.

teaching.sourceExcerpt: Make something without a requirement to share, keep or judge it. Notice evaluation when it appears and return to making. Compare the experience with your usual process.
teaching.sourceLimits: This manuscript passage describes a practice; it does not establish a guaranteed creative or emotional result. No preferred feeling, finished work, audience or saved creation is required.

feedback.unavailable: Private notes cannot be saved here. You can keep working without them.
feedback.missing: Add a note before saving, or leave this reflection blank.
feedback.length: Shorten the note to 2,000 characters or fewer to save. Your full draft stays in this field.
feedback.readFailure: Saved notes could not be loaded. Your current note stays on this screen.
feedback.conflict: The saved note changed elsewhere. Review your note, then save again.
feedback.readbackFailure: The save could not be confirmed. Retry to check the same save.
feedback.saveFailure: The save is uncertain. Retry the same note.
feedback.retryPending: The earlier save is unresolved. Retry it before changing your note.

source.limits: This locally authored lesson is source-checked instructional material, not an outcome study. It does not ask learners to feel good, prove spontaneity, finish, preserve or share their work.
source.distinctions: A voluntary private experiment can pause public evaluation without avoiding necessary standards or commitments in work others depend on.
